findings.title: Missing pipeline artifacts (architecture.json, implementation.json)
findings.evidence: The Volibear pipeline expects architecture.json and implementation.json as inputs to the reviewer stage, but neither file was found in the repository. The reviewer proceeded by reading source code directly.
findings.recommendation: Ensure upstream stages (architecture, implementation) write their artifacts to the expected run directory so the reviewer has structured context.

findings.title: No JSDoc on public exported function
findings.evidence: The helloWorld() function is exported from the @volibear/core barrel but lacks JSDoc documentation.
findings.recommendation: Add a brief JSDoc comment describing the function's purpose for consumers of the package.

summary: The implementation is correct: helloWorld() returns 'Hello, World!' as a properly typed string, is exported from the @volibear/core barrel, and has two passing tests (value + type check). No critical or high severity findings. The only medium finding is a missing pipeline artifact, which is a process concern rather than a code defect.
